description: NYY, 2005 June regular phase: 50 of 50 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 50 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 50 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20250707222509: 50 listed, 50 matched to MLB's picks by name (6 by surname in the same round: #559 MLB "Joseph Burke" / "Joe Burke"; #589 MLB "James Conroy" / "Jim Conroy"; #679 MLB "Michael Lee" / "Mike Lee"; #769 MLB "Bradley Canada" / "Brad Canada"; #1009 MLB "Michael Mlotkowski" / "Mike Mlotkowski"; #1069 MLB "Andrew Carter" / "Andy Carter")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.

sources.notes: League-wide JSON, 1501 selections; sha256 188465d02300b092f4d534c5779d02c80ecf4f94b98348687d1d7f322a26886e. Supplies pick, round, franchise-stable team id, MLBAM person, school label. No signing data. Terms: individual, non-commercial, non-bulk use (research/history/sources.json).
